displayName: TenantKeep Posture for Azure, Teams and Power Platform
notes: TenantKeep Posture for Azure, Teams and Power Platform: the second sign-in of a run, for three APIs that offer no read-only permission. Each has one delegated permission, to act as the signed-in administrator, so they are kept off the shared TenantKeep registration, which holds read-only permissions only. Public client, delegated only, no credentials, owned by Kainor LLC. The module reads through it and nothing else: Azure requests and queries are GET and Resource Graph only, Teams commands are Get- only, and Power Platform is three GETs and the one POST that lists tenant settings, each through an entry point the tests hold to that. Used by Posture alone; TenantKeep On-Call never signs in to it. A customer who wants none of the three never approves it, and Power Platform is optional within it.
